insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured options vary by plan (e.g., 5/10/15/20/25/50/100/200 Lakhs depending on plan as per Annexure C). Exact Sum Insured is as per Policy Schedule.

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: Room rent limit shall be At Actuals unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule.
great.explanation: Room rent is covered at actual cost unless your policy schedule states otherwise. This means you can choose any room without worrying about a daily rent cap.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: The Secure Benefit will be applicable only after exhaustion of Base Sum Insured.
great.explanation: You get extra insurer-funded coverage once your Base Sum Insured is fully used. This provides additional financial protection beyond your base limit.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: The restored Sum Insured can be used even for the same illness for which an admissible claim has been paid during the Policy Year and also for any other Illness covered under the Policy.
great.explanation: If your Sum Insured is exhausted or partly used after a claim, the policy restores 100% of it. You can use this restored amount even for the same illness within the same policy year.

great.name: No Claim Bonus
great.quote: This Cover will be applied irrespective of number of claims made under the expiring Policy.
great.explanation: The renewal bonus is credited even if you made claims in the previous year. This means your bonus does not reset to zero after a claim.

great.name: Consumables
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Insured Person for the Non-Medical Expenses listed under Annexure B to this Policy incurred in relation to a claim admissible under Section B-1 (Base Coverage) during the Policy Year.
great.explanation: If Protect Benefit is active, many common non-medical hospital items are covered. This reduces your out-of-pocket expenses for consumables.

great.name: PED Waiting Period
great.quote: Modification of PED waiting period from 36 months (as specified under Section C.1.a  Pre-Existing Diseases) to 24 months (2 years)... to 12 months (1 year)
great.explanation: If this option applies, the waiting period for pre-existing diseases can reduce to 24 or even 12 months. This means you can claim for pre-existing conditions sooner.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered in the first 30 days except accidents. This is standard and protects against immediate claims.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months (Unless specified otherwise in the Policy Schedule) of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered only after 36 months of continuous coverage. This is a common waiting period in Indian health insurance.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Certain listed illnesses and procedures have a 24-month waiting period. Accidents are exempt from this waiting.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Such expenses shall be indemnified if the same were incurred upto 60 days unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule, immediately prior to the date of admission.
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 60 days before hospital admission are covered. This helps with costs related to your hospitalization.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Such expenses shall be indemnified if the same were incurred upto 180 days unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule, immediately post the date of discharge from the Hospital.
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 180 days after discharge are covered. This supports recovery costs after hospitalization.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify expenses incurred by the Insured Person during the Policy Year towards Ambulance transportation in an airplane or helicopter for Emergency Care... subject to a maximum of Sum Insured as specified in the Policy Schedule against this Cover
good.explanation: Air ambulance expenses are covered if this optional benefit is active, subject to limits. This helps in emergency transport by air.

bad.name: Consumables Exclusion
bad.quote: Any Kit with no details mentioned [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHO KIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC.] ... GLOVES ... MASK ... VASOFIX SAFETY
bad.reference: Annexure B - Items for which Coverage is not available in the Policy (Non-Medical Expenses), Pages 49-50
bad.explanation: Many common consumables are excluded from coverage under the base policy. This can lead to significant out-of-pocket expenses unless you have additional benefits.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-Payment means a cost sharing requirement under a health insurance policy that provides that the policyholder/insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claims amount.
bad.explanation: The policy defines co-pay but does not clearly state if or when it applies by default. You need to check your policy schedule to know if any co-pay applies.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
